title: Evasion Mantle
content:
# Evasion Mantle

Internal ID: TrinketBlackStamina | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Black metal x5, Fuling berserker trophy x1, Linen thread x10 | Adrenaline Cost: 60 | Effect: -50% Block stamina usage | +50% Parry bonus | +20 Dodge skill | Duration: 2m

# Introduction

Evasion Mantle is a Plains-tier trinket.

## Effects

Once 60 Adrenaline has been gained, the Evasion Mantle will trigger automatically, providing -50% Block stamina usage, +50% Parry bonus, and +20 Dodge skill for 120 seconds.
The Evasion Mantle parry bonus increases the block armor when Parrying. It is multiplicative with the regular item parry bonus.

Categorias: Trinket
